folders.folders.title: Authorize folders
folders.folders.addNote: Once authorized, every agent can read files here without asking you, and what it reads is sent to your model provider; ergo also looks here when finding photos and files. You can see and change this in Settings · Folder grants
folders.folders.removeNote: Once removed, ergo no longer looks here for files, and reading files here goes back to the usual rules. You can see and change this in Settings · Folder grants
folders.folders.summary: {what}. You can see and change this in Settings · Folder grants
folders.browse.missing: This folder doesn't exist on this computer
folders.browse.noPermission: No permission to read this folder
folders.local.missing: This folder doesn't exist on this computer: {path}
folders.local.tooManyAdding: You can authorize at most {max} folders: there are {kept} now, and adding {added} more would go over
folders.local.tooMany: You can authorize at most {max} folders
folders.grants.notAbsolute: Write the full path (for example D:\Notes): {path}
folders.grants.missing: There's no such folder on this computer: {path}
folders.grants.forbidden: {path} is inside ergo's data folder or program folder and can't be registered
folders.grants.noTable: {agentId} has no folder grants: only the personal assistant and project and task owners have them
folders.grants.noModes: Tick at least one kind of access (read, write, delete)
folders.grants.pastExpiry: The expiry time has to be later than now: {at}
folders.grants.tooMany: One agent can register at most {max} folders
folders.grants.expiringBody: The folder grant for {agent} on {path} ({modes}) expires {at} and stops working after that. To keep it, register it again in Settings · Folder grants.
